description:
Create an isometric piping diagram (installation sketch) for a cooling water loop in Wondershare EdrawMax.

1. Create a new diagram using the 'Industrial Engineering' or 'Piping' category.
2. Locate the Industrial Engineering / Piping shape libraries (look for pictorial/3D-style shapes, not 2D symbols).
3. Place three main equipment components from left to right:
   - A vertical storage tank
   - A centrifugal pump (positioned lower/central)
   - A shell-and-tube heat exchanger
4. Connect them with pipelines (lines):
   - Connect Tank bottom to Pump inlet.
   - Connect Pump outlet to Heat Exchanger inlet.
5. Add isolation valves on the piping:
   - One valve on the line between Tank and Pump.
   - One valve on the line between Pump and Heat Exchanger.
6. Add the following text labels to identify the equipment:
   - 'Feed Tank T-100'
   - 'Circulation Pump P-101'
   - 'Cooler HX-200'
7. Add a title text at the top: 'Cooling Loop Installation Sketch'.
8. Save the diagram as '/home/ga/Diagrams/cooling_loop_iso.eddx'.
9. Export the diagram as an image to '/home/ga/Diagrams/cooling_loop_iso.png'.
